auth_note: Access to the API must be requested and granted, then a token is created in the Lens user profile.
bulk_access: Bulk Data Downloads of scholarly and patent files via the API or UI (https://docs.api.lens.org/bulk-data.html); access is requested from the Lens account
probe_observation: The anonymous probe returned HTTP 401 JSON with message 'Missing/Incorrect Authorization Header'.

evidence.quote: Granted access to our API service ( request access ). ... Create an Access Token from your user profile page.
Lens uses token-based API authentication, you can request access and manage your access plan and tokens from your Lens user profile.
Once you go over any rate limit you will receive a 429 - Too many requests error with respective messages.
Bulk data downloads enable users to download scholarly and patent bulk data files via the API or UI.
